name: "Design Your Own" Pita Pizzas with Bell Peppers, Mushrooms & Olives (Cooking with Kids)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe contains steps that can be done by smaller hands! You know your child (and their cooking abilities) best, so get them involved where you feel comfortable. Have fun!
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ green bell pepper
½ yellow bell pepper
¼ lb white mushrooms

instructions.primary_message: Trim, seed, and slice bell peppers lengthwise into thin strips. Place on a plate.
Thinly slice mushrooms. Add to the plate with the bell pepper.
Drain olives. Add to the plate and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: ½ (3.8 oz) can sliced black olives

instructions.primary_message: Place cheese and pizza sauce each in their own small bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 cups shredded cheese, Italian blend
1 (14 oz) jar pizza sauce

instructions.primary_message: Divide pita breads between two baking sheet pans. Get the kids to help decorate each pita with sauce, cheese, and veggies. Create faces, flowers, fun designs, or anything else that comes to the imagination!
Place baking sheets in the oven and bake until cheese is melted, 8-10 minutes. Remove from oven and allow to cool slightly, 5 minutes.
Cut pizzas into wedges, divide between plates, and enjoy!
